name: Bybee-Nims Farm
description: Bybee-Nims Farm is an agritourism farm in 42900 Southeast 92nd Street, WA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
